changelog:
alibabacloud-sls-index-config-management v0.0.1 – Initial Release

- Provides management of Alibaba Cloud SLS (Simple Log Service) Logstore index configurations via aliyun CLI.
- Supports inspecting, creating, updating, deleting, generating, and optimizing index configuration.
- Requires AI mode enablement and credential/security checks before operations.
- Outputs both complete JSON and human-readable summaries for all index configurations.
- Includes detailed routing to relevant reference guides for each scenario.
